Kofi's RESP contribution for this month

evidence_refs: Contribute $200.00 from the household account to Kofi's RESP this month, and tell me how much education savings grant it earns.
actions.rationale: Daniel contributes 200.00 CAD to his son Kofi's RESP as his guardian; the CESG on it (40.00) comes from cesg_room, not from the planner.

notes: cesg_room(kofi, 200.00): basic 20% = 40.00; grant 40.00; this year's room 500.00 before, 460.00 after; lifetime room 7160.00 of 7200.00 after; Kofi is 14 this year, eligible until the end of the year he turns 17 (canada.ca, Estimating amounts, fetched 2026-09-12).
The RESP provider requests the CESG from the government on the contribution; this ledger only records the contribution itself.
